Write only the paragraph, without greetings, pleasantries, or sign-offs. Use every number exactly as given, with its unit; never turn an arrival delay into a departure delay or days into hours.

message.content: I was scheduled to depart Warsaw (WAW) on flight VQ507 operated by VQ at 2026-08-05T12:00:00 bound for New York (JFK). The flight was delayed due to a crew shortage caused by a rostering mistake, and I arrived at JFK 210 minutes (3 h 30 min) later than the scheduled arrival time.
